scope: Gate A UI component fixture only; no stacked geometry/clearance/105-relations/CAS/history/save/installed-host or physical-device proof
checks: actual floor controller/widget shows five labels on fifteen declared floors and preserves nonuniform native elevations
owned PageUp/PageDown guards forms/dialogs/IME/modifiers/repeats and keeps selector wheel separate from canvas zoom
actual widget wheel gate latches a long burst and honours separate 179/180 ms gesture boundaries
stack form submits exact source identity, declared member IDs and requested minimum without inventing relations or lowering clearance
friendly typed finishes use fixed IDs, respect locks and reject an in-session version mapping change
all eight original workspace witnesses block mounted stack/finish/apply and stale form events; valid identity changes retire until an explicit fresh mount
workspace identity retirement invalidates pending UI replies without cancelling or replacing the borrowed Editor authority
native activation stays single and separate; unknown actions freeze, recovery keeps its ID and retry is presentation-only
late replies, malformed refreshes and same-named host inputs cannot acquire action/focus authority
component disposal releases its subscriptions/widget while preserving borrowed floor/controller/adapter ownership
unchanged actual input owner preserves native UI-first/quarantine/capture-loss/floor cancellation and fresh-primary recovery
390/320 px native touch retains five-floor labels, readable native heights, 44 px targets and no overflow

controlledWheel.method: Fresh actual DOM widget; synthetic timestamps only, never mixed with the native gate
